hold.q: How much is held from my earnings?
hold.a: A percentage of your earnings is held for security: unverified agents 100%, verified agents 80%, internal agents 0%. Verify your account and add a profile photo to reduce the hold amount.

verifiedLessHold.q: Why do verified agents have less hold?

release.a: Settlements are released within 24-48 hours after order completion, depending on your payment method.

failedDeliveries.a: When a delivery fails, the agent marks it with a failure reason. The business can resolve the failed delivery (agent fault, item issue, customer fault). Resolutions are tracked in the Failed deliveries section.

howToClaim.q: How do I claim an order?

whenPaid.q: When do I get paid after a delivery?
whenPaid.a: Once the order is marked delivered and confirmed by the customer, your balance is updated: the caution is released and the delivery commission is credited. Actual settlement is within 24-48 hours depending on your payment method.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Rendasua ("we," "our," or "us") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our mobile apps and platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling personal data responsibly.
privacy.personalInfoText: We collect information you provide when you create an account, place an order, or contact support, such as your name, email address, phone number, delivery addresses, and payment-related details processed by our payment partners.
privacy.locationInfoText: Depending on how you use Rendasua, we may collect device location data, including precise GPS coordinates. Delivery agents: when you use the Rendasua Agent app as a delivery agent, we collect your location while you are logged in and, if you grant permission, while the app is in the background or not in use, so customers with active deliveries can follow delivery progress. We send location updates to our servers and may display your position to customers linked to orders you are delivering. Clients: we may use your location when you choose features such as filling an address from GPS or viewing maps. You can control location permissions in your device settings at any time.
